title: Commands: init and ask
lead: `dlog init` creates the store and a config; `dlog ask` creates an open record.
boundary: **Not in this slice:** decide, reject, withdraw, show and list.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Goal 1: capture an open question with options and a recommendation in one
command.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
The `cli` and `commands` modules from the Architecture sketch, and end-to-end
CLI tests against temp directories.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `dlog init` in an empty temp dir creates the store and config; running it
  again does not destroy existing records.
- `dlog ask TITLE --option LABEL:SUMMARY ... --recommend LABEL [--key K]
  [--tag T] [--context TEXT|--stdin]` creates one `open` record with those
  fields and a history line.
- `--recommend` with a label that is not one of the options fails with a
  non-zero exit.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
Wire argparse subcommands to the store. Gap: PROJECT.md gives
`--option LABEL:SUMMARY` only; it does not say how to pass `tradeoffs` from the
CLI. Ask the owner, or leave tradeoffs to editing the file.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- The project test command passes.
- `slicer check --json` is clean.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body:
Worktree under `.worktrees/` on a feature branch. No commit unless the owner
asks; no AI attribution.
